image_description: A dark, curved wooden bookcase filled with books and various decorative objects. The bookcase has multiple shelves and appears to be situated in a room with warm lighting. The perspective is slightly low-angle, looking up at the shelves.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular furniture piece of considerable height, notably taller than wide.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bookcase is distinctly curved/arched rather than rectangular. While it is tall, the primary geometric descriptor 'rectangular' fails due to the significant curvature of the top and sides.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tall rectangular frame with horizontal divisions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Similar to above, the frame is not rectangular; it follows a curved silhouette. Horizontal divisions (shelves) are present but conform to the curve.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object lacks bilateral symmetry due to its asymmetrical loading of books/objects and the curved, non-symmetrical perspective/design. The front is open.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Front open displaying books and objects on each shelf.

The surface is finished (dark stain/paint). No distinct hardware like knobs is visible, but the finish qualifies.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The top molding/cornice of the bookcase appears to melt or warp unnaturally into the background wall. The geometry loses definition and seems to blend with the ceiling/wall texture, lacking a sharp physical boundary.

The perspective on the shelves is inconsistent. Some books appear to float or lean at impossible angles relative to the shelf plane. The curvature of the shelves creates a warping effect that makes the rigid objects (books) appear soft or bent.

The spines of the books lack distinct text or clear detail, appearing as smeared color blocks. This is common in AI generation but represents a loss of expected fine-grained texture for printed materials.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the bookcase near the wall
artifact_observations.reasoning: The right vertical support of the bookcase seems to fuse slightly with the background wall and the adjacent furniture/object, lacking a clean occlusion boundary.
